def constraints_hold(z):
    # Exactly one of Parra/Tiao works in Zone 1.
    c1 = (z["Parra"] == 1) != (z["Tiao"] == 1)
    # Exactly one of Tiao/Udall works in Zone 2.

    # Parra and Quinn share a zone.

    # Stuckey and Udall share a zone.

    # More reps in Zone 3 than Zone 2.

    n3 = sum(1 for r in REPS if z[r] == 3)
    c5 = n3 > n2
    return c1 and c2 and c3 and c4 and c5
